purpose: Exploratory interval-aware diagnostics on retained outcomes; original SR and Cherian interval procedures are not implemented.
data: Reuse first120 saved repetitions of ALL seven newer_baselines_v1 scenarios; no new audit outcomes or model fits.
methods: Published SAFT Algorithm1 branch: Wald only if min(k_g,n_g-k_g,k_complement,n_complement-k_complement)>=30; otherwise four-cell counts+1 Dirichlet posterior represented by independent conditional Beta ratios. Local FNR adaptation and tolerance rule remain explicit.
simultaneous Clopper-Pearson/BONFERRONI group-rate rectangle propagated to weighted-complement contrasts, family alpha.05
metrics: any truly nonharmful cell lower-endpoint>.05 frequency
zero-disparity global-null native two-sided rejection frequency
decision_scope: Wald/SAFT pointwise intervals carry no familywise error guarantee. CP rectangle has simultaneous guarantee under group-binomial assumptions. Do not rank unequal error targets as fair power comparison. Native SAFT two-sided zero null is reported separately from the adapted tolerance rule.
reporting: All settings, failures and Monte Carlo standard errors are retained. The diagnostic is exploratory and uses no new audit outcomes or classifier fits.
quantile_method: inverted_cdf, matching the published inverse empirical CDF definition
correction_basis: Official published paper p6 Algorithm1 and p5 quantile definition; https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2025/file/8cdc8e07038dcd423d382048b7063d07-Paper-Conference.pdf
